title_en: Provisions of the State Council on Encouraging Investments by Overseas Chinese and Compatriots from Hong Kong and Macao

articles.content_en: These Provisions are formulated to promote China's economic development and to encourage overseas Chinese and compatriots from Hong Kong and Macao (hereinafter collectively referred to as overseas Chinese and Hong Kong/Macao investors) to invest within China.

Overseas Chinese and Hong Kong/Macao investors may invest in the various provinces, autonomous regions, municipalities directly under the Central Government, and special economic zones within China.
Overseas Chinese and Hong Kong/Macao investors are encouraged to engage in land development and operation in accordance with the relevant state provisions.

Overseas Chinese and Hong Kong/Macao investors may invest in industry, agriculture, service industries and other sectors that are in line with the direction of social and economic development within China. Overseas Chinese and Hong Kong/Macao investors may select investment projects from those published by the relevant departments of the local people's governments, or may propose their own investment project intentions and apply to the department of foreign economic relations and trade of the area in which they intend to invest or the examination and approval authority designated by the local people's government.
The State encourages overseas Chinese and Hong Kong/Macao investors to invest in establishing export-oriented enterprises and technologically advanced enterprises, and shall grant them corresponding preferential treatment.

Where overseas Chinese and Hong Kong/Macao investors invest within China in establishing enterprises with all capital invested by them, equity joint ventures, and contractual joint ventures (hereinafter collectively referred to as enterprises with investment by overseas Chinese and Hong Kong/Macao compatriots), in addition to the application of these Provisions, the provisions of the relevant state laws and regulations concerning foreign economic relations shall be applied mutatis mutandis, and they shall enjoy the corresponding treatment for enterprises with foreign investment.
Where overseas Chinese and Hong Kong/Macao investors make other forms of investment within China, and where they have no business establishment within China but have dividends, interest, rent, royalties and other income derived from within China, in addition to the application of these Provisions, the provisions of the relevant state laws and regulations concerning foreign economic relations may also be applied mutatis mutandis.

Overseas Chinese and Hong Kong/Macao investors may invest with convertible foreign currencies, machinery and equipment or other tangible assets, industrial property rights, proprietary technology, and the like.

The investments, purchased assets, industrial property rights, profits derived from investments and other lawful rights and interests of overseas Chinese and Hong Kong/Macao investors within China shall be protected by the state laws, and may be transferred and inherited according to law.
Overseas Chinese and Hong Kong/Macao investors shall abide by the state laws and regulations in their activities within China.
The State shall not nationalize the investments and other assets of overseas Chinese and Hong Kong/Macao investors.

Where the State, in the interest of social public interest, expropriates an enterprise with investment by overseas Chinese and Hong Kong/Macao compatriots, it shall proceed in accordance with legal procedures and grant appropriate compensation.
The lawful profits, other lawful income and funds after liquidation obtained by overseas Chinese and Hong Kong/Macao investors from their investments may be remitted abroad according to law.

Enterprises with investment by overseas Chinese and Hong Kong/Macao compatriots shall, within their total investment, be exempted from import customs duties and the consolidated industrial and commercial tax and shall be exempted from import license requirements for importing machinery and equipment, production vehicles and office equipment required by the enterprise, as well as for importing reasonable quantities of daily necessities and means of transport for personal use by overseas Chinese and Hong Kong/Macao compatriots during their work in the enterprise.
Enterprises with investment by overseas Chinese and Hong Kong/Macao compatriots shall be exempted from import customs duties and the consolidated industrial and commercial tax and shall be exempted from import license requirements for importing raw materials, fuel, CKD components, spare parts, components, and auxiliary parts used for producing export products, and such imports shall be subject to customs supervision. If the above-mentioned imported materials and parts are used in products sold within China, the import formalities shall be gone through retroactively and the taxes shall be paid according to the relevant state provisions.
Export products produced by enterprises with investment by overseas Chinese and Hong Kong/Macao compatriots, except those restricted by the State for export, shall be exempted from export customs duties and the consolidated industrial and commercial tax.

Enterprises with investment by overseas Chinese and Hong Kong/Macao compatriots may borrow funds from financial institutions within China and may also borrow funds from financial institutions outside China, and may use the assets and rights and interests of the enterprise as mortgage or guarantee.

For enterprises with all capital invested by overseas Chinese and Hong Kong/Macao investors, the term of operation shall be determined by the investors on their own; for equity joint ventures and contractual joint ventures, the term of operation shall be determined through negotiation by the parties to the joint venture or cooperation, or the term of operation may not be specified.

The composition of the board of directors and the appointment of the chairman of an equity joint venture, and the composition of the board of directors or the joint management body and the appointment of the chairman or the director of the joint management body of a contractual joint venture, may be determined through consultation by the parties to the joint venture or cooperation by reference to the investment ratio or the cooperative conditions.

Enterprises with investment by overseas Chinese and Hong Kong/Macao compatriots shall conduct their business management activities in accordance with the approved contracts and articles of association. The autonomous right of business management of the enterprise shall not be interfered with.

Overseas Chinese and Hong Kong/Macao compatriots who invest within China, as well as technical and managerial personnel employed from abroad by enterprises with investment by overseas Chinese and Hong Kong/Macao compatriots, may apply for multiple entry and exit documents.
Overseas Chinese and Hong Kong/Macao investors investing within China may entrust their relatives or friends within China as their agents. The agent shall hold a legally valid power of attorney.

In areas where enterprises with investment by overseas Chinese and Hong Kong/Macao compatriots are concentrated, overseas Chinese and Hong Kong/Macao investors may apply to the local people's government for the establishment of an association of overseas Chinese and Hong Kong/Macao investors.

Where overseas Chinese and Hong Kong/Macao investors invest within China in establishing equity joint ventures or contractual joint ventures, the application shall be made by the Chinese party to the joint venture or cooperation; where they establish enterprises with all capital invested by them, the application shall be made directly by the overseas Chinese and Hong Kong/Macao investors or by their relatives, friends, consulting service agencies, etc. within China on their behalf. Applications for the establishment of enterprises by overseas Chinese and Hong Kong/Macao investors shall be accepted uniformly by the local department of foreign economic relations and trade or the examination and approval authority designated by the local people's government.
The examination and approval of enterprises with investment by overseas Chinese and Hong Kong/Macao compatriots shall be handled within the limits of authority prescribed by the State Council. The department of foreign economic relations and trade at various levels or the examination and approval authority designated by the local people's government shall, within forty-five days from the date of receipt of all application documents, decide whether to approve or disapprove.
The applicant shall, within thirty days from the date of receipt of the certificate of approval, apply for registration with the administrative authority for industry and commerce in accordance with the relevant registration management measures and obtain a business license.

Disputes arising from the performance of a contract or relating to a contract in respect of investment by overseas Chinese and Hong Kong/Macao investors within China shall be settled by the parties as far as possible through consultation or mediation.
Where the parties are unwilling to engage in consultation or mediation, or where consultation or mediation fails, the dispute may be submitted to an arbitration institution within China or another arbitration institution for arbitration in accordance with the arbitration clause in the contract or a written arbitration agreement reached afterwards.
Where the parties have not included an arbitration clause in the contract and have not entered into a written arbitration agreement afterwards, they may bring a prosecution before a People's Court.
These Provisions shall be interpreted by the Ministry of Foreign Economic Relations and Trade.
These Provisions shall come into force on the date of promulgation.
